svg.title: Fig. 2 — How a battle works
svg.desc: Fig. 2 — How a battle works, drawn as a request path: 1. User prompt (one real prompt, two models) → 2. Cloudflare CDN (absorbs traffic spikes) → 3. .NET Web API (stateless · scales out) → 4. Cloudflare AI Gateway (rate limits · cache · logs) → 5. Model A / Model B (identities hidden) → 6. Community vote (on the two answers) → 7. Supabase · PostgreSQL (the live leaderboard). Why it is built this way: CDN first, stateless API — Spikes land on Cloudflare, not the origin; scaling the .NET API out is a config change. AI Gateway over direct calls — One place for rate limits, caching and per-request logs across every model provider. Supabase on purpose — Leaderboard ranking needs relational queries. Names are revealed only after the vote. Docs: docs.dualmindlab.tech.
